title: German Apple Strudel
description: A classic German dessert made with sweet apples, crunchy pastry, and a hint of spice.

ingredients.name: sweet apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other tart variety

instructions: Peel, core, and slice the sweet apples. Set aside.
Roll out the flaky pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together the sliced apples, crunchy sugar, and date syrup (if using).
Place the apple mixture along the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border on either side.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water.
Fold the pastry over the apple mixture, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the strudel with a little milk or beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
